about: Project reference list (BSD-3-Clause). Every sourced value in data/ carries one of these keys; docs/references.md is generated from this file by tools/gen_dye_library.mjs. 'checked' says how the citation (and, where stated, the values taken from it) was verified.

lambert2019.title: FPbase: a community-editable fluorescent protein database
lambert2019.use: dye and fluorescent-protein spectra, peak wavelengths, extinction coefficients, quantum yields, lifetimes; filter and camera QE curves (data CC BY-SA 4.0)
lambert2019.checked: citation via Europe PMC; data fetched from the FPbase GraphQL API by tools/fetch_fpbase.mjs

dempsey2011.authors: Dempsey GT, Vaughan JC, Chen KH, Bates M, Zhuang X
dempsey2011.title: Evaluation of fluorophores for optimal performance in localization-based super-resolution imaging
dempsey2011.use: dSTORM switching: detected photons per cycle, equilibrium duty cycle, switching cycles (Table 1, GLOX + 10 mM MEA) at their measurement intensities (488 nm 1.2, 561 nm 2.2, 647 nm 0.8 kW/cm^2; Methods); 405 nm activation sensitivity (Table 2); photons per cycle and duty cycle largely independent of intensity (emission, off- and on-switching linear in it; Results, Supplementary Fig. 32): the intensity scaling of dSTORM ON and dark times
dempsey2011.checked: Table 1 and 2 values, the intensities and the intensity-dependence statements read from the Europe PMC full text (PMC3272503)

turkowyd2017.authors: Turkowyd B, Balinovic A, Virant D, Carnero HGG, Caldana F, Endesfelder M, Bourgeois D, Endesfelder U
turkowyd2017.title: A General Mechanism of Photoconversion of Green-to-Red Fluorescent Proteins Based on Blue and Infrared Light Reduces Phototoxicity in Live-Cell Single-Molecule Imaging
turkowyd2017.use: primed conversion (blue priming + near-infrared conversion) of green-to-red FPs; Dendra2-type proteins convert well, wild-type mEos-type poorly (residue 69)
turkowyd2017.checked: citation and abstract via Europe PMC; no rate constants taken from it (the primed coefficients are estimates)
